title: PACT Service Account Create Request
description: Request body for POST /api/pact/service-accounts. A service account is TRANSPORT IDENTITY — it answers 'which automated client is calling'. It is NOT a substitute for proof of human intent: a cross-organisation message still requires a valid 17.6 authorization_proof at the Authorization-Required tier (22.2). Added in PACT v2.1 (Section 22.3).

owner_principal_id.description: DID of the HumanPrincipal accountable for this account.

resources.description: Resource / fabric ids the account may act on. Empty or absent means NO resource access — never 'all'.

sections.description: Section ids within those resources. Absent = all sections of the named resources.

may_mint.description: Permits minting Section 20 Mandates. The Mandate's signature is STILL the HumanPrincipal's (20.5 step 4) — a service account never signs a Mandate on a human's behalf.

max_disclosure_ceiling.description: Caps the disclosure_ceiling of any Mandate minted through this account, independent of what the handler requests.

scope.description: Scope dimensions. An update MAY narrow a scope; it MUST NOT widen one (widening requires a new account, so an audit trail always shows the grant) — an attempt MUST be rejected with scope.widening_forbidden.

expires_at.description: Optional expiry. Absent or null = no implicit expiry; implementations SHOULD still require rotation.
